subject: SLA alignment for Halogen private deployment
messages:
From: Eli Thompson <eli@halogen.io>
To: david_kim <david@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya@halogen.io>
Date: Fri, 10 Feb 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: SLA alignment for Halogen private deployment

Hi David —

Thanks for taking this on. We are nearly done with the on-prem stack and expect to flip traffic to the Halogen edge next month. A few items for SLAs we need clarity on before we go live:

- Our edge routers and transit are customer-managed (we own colo, routers, and the primary peering). We see occasional 10–30s token-generation spikes tied to packet loss/jitter; this impacts our app-level P95 latency.
- We need either explicit attribution language in the SLA or an exclusion carveout so we are not held to Redwood's latency SLO when this customer-controlled path is the root cause.
- We will share a network diagram and a short pcap/latency sample if that helps.

Can Redwood propose an operational and contractual approach? Ideally we want: (a) an evidence-based attribution workflow, (b) example wording for a responsibility paragraph, and (c) any dashboarding/alerting hooks you need from our side.

Attaching a short one-page summary and we can schedule a technical sync next week.

Thanks —
Eli Thompson
Head of Infrastructure, Halogen Therapeutics
eli@halogen.io

Eli —

Appreciate the details and the heads-up. Short answer: yes, we can support an evidence-driven attribution model and draft a responsibility appendix for the Private deployment.

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) Send the network diagram and a 24–72 hour latency sample (pcap or aggregated metrics).
2) We will draft a proposed SLA appendix with:
   - definition of "customer-controlled network events"
   - attribution process (logs, packet captures, timestamped request traces)
   - remediation/mitigation playbook and expected timelines
3) Technical sync (30–45m) with our infra and your ops to confirm metrics and SRE runbooks.

Irene, Naomi — can you take the lead on drafting the appendix and the operational checklist? I'm happy to join the sync and shepherd the contractual language (we'll aim to keep the amendment tight and specific).

Eli — I'm free Wed 14th 09:00–11:00 PT or Thu 15th 14:00–16:00 PT for a call. Which works?

Best,
David Kim
Director, Technical Sales — Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 13 Feb 2028 13:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SLA alignment for Halogen private deployment

David / team —

I started a draft of the appendix. Key technical points I want to make sure we capture:

- Attribution criteria: For a latency event to be attributed to "customer-controlled network", Halogen must provide:
  * timestamped request IDs mapped to packet captures or platform metrics showing packet loss/RTT spikes overlapping the request window, and
  * evidence that host-level CPU/memory/LLM runtime metrics were within normal bounds during the incident (so we can rule out local overload).
- Fallback routing: If Halogen has configured multiple paths, we need documentation of failover behavior; otherwise we can't assume Redwood can route around their edge.
- SLO impact treatment: propose that incidents where >=80% of affected requests have correlating network-layer pathology documented by the customer be considered "customer-attributed" for latency SLOs.

I'll mark up the draft with sample contractual wording ("Customer-Managed Network Attribution Clause") and include a short evidence checklist for legal and your procurement team.

Note: we should avoid absolute carveouts; instead, use an "attribution and mitigation" model to keep both sides accountable.

-Irene
Irene Choi
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Eli Thompson <eli@halogen.io>
To: david_kim <david@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya@halogen.io>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 08:52:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SLA alignment for Halogen private deployment

David / Irene —

Thanks. Attached are: halogen_network_diagram_v2.png and a small zip of latency samples (halogen_latency_samples_202801.zip). The samples cover a recent 48-hour window with two visible jitter incidents; we've annotated timestamps in a CSV inside the zip.

A few clarifications from our side:
- We can provide packet captures for specific incidents but cannot provide persistent full-packet capture for privacy reasons; hope the short-term captures and metrics suffice.
- We operate an active/passive edge pair; failover is not instantaneous (typically 60–90s during our controlled tests).

We like the "attribution and mitigation" approach. Can Redwood send a short sample clause we can run by Legal? Also would appreciate if the clause references the evidence checklist you mentioned so our SREs know what to collect.

I'll take Wed 14th 10:30–11:00 PT if that helps (slightly different from your windows) — otherwise Thu 15th 14:00 PT is good.

Eli

Subject: Re: SLA alignment for Halogen private deployment

Eli —

Thanks for the artifacts; they help a lot. Attached is our proposed amendment draft (proposed-sla-amendment-draft.docx) with the following high-level approach:

- Customer-Managed Network Attribution Clause (sample):
  "Where customer-managed network components are in the request path (\"Customer Network\"), Redwood will treat latency and availability incidents as Customer-attributed if the Customer provides contemporaneous evidence demonstrating network-layer pathology coincident with the affected requests. Such evidence shall include timestamped request IDs, packet captures or equivalent network metrics, and host-level runtime metrics that collectively indicate packet loss, excessive retransmission, or RTT spikes. Incidents not meeting this evidence threshold remain Redwood responsibility under standard SLA terms."

- Evidence checklist appended (what we expect from Halogen SREs).
- Operational runbook: steps for joint validation calls, expected timelines for triage, and temporary mitigation options (rate-limiting, prefixed caching, or routing to a backup region) while attribution is determined.

If Halogen agrees in principle we can formalize the clause in an addendum, have Legal do a quick pass, and then attach it to the Private deployment agreement. Naomi, Tessa — please prepare the short evidence checklist and a 1-page runbook we can hand to Eli's SREs.

Eli — please confirm whether you prefer the call Wed 14th 10:30–11:00 PT (Irene and Naomi will join) or Thu 15th 14:00 PT (full team). Also indicate when Halogen Legal would like to review the draft.

Best,
David Kim
Director, Technical Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed-sla-amendment-draft.docx
